title: Improved charge separation and transport with L-aspartic acid derived carbon-doped g-C3N4 for efficient visible-light photocatalytic H2 production
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01264J, Paper
Ikram Ullah, Ning Qin, Pei Zhao, Jing-Han Li, Shuai Chen, An-Wu Xu
Carbon-doped graphitic carbon nitride photocatalysts were prepared through one-step calcination utilizing L-aspartic acid and urea. With the optimal CCN-8 6.6 times higher H2 evolution rate was obtained than that of pristine CN under visible light.
